name: Meowhalla
source:
What can be better than cat girls? Only cat girls—Vikings! Meet the visual novel that will tell you an awesome story about cat girl intrigues in the outskirts of Valhalla.

You as an ordinary human arrive in the suburb of Valhalla named the Threshold, which acts like a purgatory for human warriors. You discover that the Threshold is ruled by the Disir sisters, a mysterious kind of creatures that look like human girls with cat ears and tails. You are involved in the disturbing times when the forces of the undead plan to invade Asgard. Only you and Disir can save Valhalla, or are you going to use this opportunity to create chaos and prioritize your own ambitions?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
还有什么比猫娘更棒？当然是维京猫娘！这部视觉小说将为你讲述一个精彩故事：英灵殿郊外，猫娘们之间的暗流与纷争。

身为普通人类的你，来到英灵殿郊外一处名为“门槛”的地方。这里对人类战士而言，就如同炼狱。你发现，此地由狄丝姐妹统治。她们是一种神秘生灵，外表与人类女孩相似，却长着猫耳和猫尾。亡灵大军正谋划入侵阿斯加德，而你也被卷入这场动荡。只有你与狄丝姐妹能够拯救英灵殿。还是说，你会借机制造混乱，优先满足自己的野心？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227490/]Steam[/url]]
